traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs perennial (shrubs or trees outside the flora).

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs or shrubs, rarely trees (P. dioica, the ombu, a tree to 25 m, FNA).

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: alternate leaves on a spiral, as across Caryophyllales' alternate-leaved families.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade ovate, elliptic or lanceolate, apex acute or obtuse.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems and branches terete, sulcate or angular.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): racemes or spikes, axillary, terminal or leaf-opposed; FOC adds cymose panicles.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 5-100-flowered.

traits.sympodium.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: FNA and FOC put the racemes leaf-opposed or terminal: the stem ends in a raceme and grows on from the bud below, leaving it opposite a leaf, as a monochasial sympodium.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tepals 5, persistent, spreading or reflexed.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5-8; FOC tepals 5.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens (7-)8-25(-30); FOC: 6-33.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): carpels 6-12(-30); FOC: 5-16.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): oblate berries with the styles persisting in a ring, or (P. acinosa) a group of lenticular achenes.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Phytolacca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): berry oblate; the vocabulary's nearest state is globose.
